shortDescription: Manage SIP profiles on a BIG-IP

options.name: community
options.description: When the C(dialog_aware) is C(true) and the configuration requires multiple SIP virtual server-profile pairings, this string value indicates whether the pair belongs to the same SIP proxy functional group.

options.name: description
options.description: Description of the profile. To remove the entry completely, set a value of C('').

options.name: dialog_aware
options.description: When C(true), the system gathers SIP dialog information and automatically forwards SIP messages belonging to the known SIP dialog.

options.name: enable_sip_firewall
options.description: Specifies whether the Advanced Firewall Manager (AFM) policy is enabled. When C(true), the SIP Security settings configured in the DoS Profile in AFM apply to the virtual servers that use this profile.

options.name: insert_record_route_header
options.description: When C(true), inserts a Record-Route SIP header, which indicates the next hop for the following SIP request messages.

options.name: insert_via_header
options.description: When C(true), inserts a Via header in the forwarded SIP request. Via headers indicate the path taken through proxy devices and transports used. The response message uses this routing information.

options.name: log_profile
options.description: Specifies the logging settings the publisher uses to send log messages. The format of the name can be either be prepended by partition (C(/Common/foo)), or specified just as an object name (C(foo)). To remove the entry. set a value of C(''), however the profile C(log_publisher) must also be set as C('').

options.name: log_publisher
options.description: Specifies the publisher defined to log messages. Format of the name can be either be prepended by partition (C(/Common/foo)), or specified just as an object name (C(foo)). To remove the entry. set a value of C(''), however the profile C(log_profile) must also be set as C('').

options.name: max_size
options.description: Specifies the maximum SIP message size that the BIG-IP system accepts. The accepted value range is C(0 - 4294967295) bytes.

options.name: name
options.description: Specifies the name of the SIP profile to manage.

options.name: parent
options.description: Specifies the profile from which this profile inherits settings. When creating a new profile, if this parameter is not specified, the default is the system-supplied C(sip) profile.

options.name: partition
options.description: Device partition to manage resources on.

options.name: provider
options.description: A dict object containing connection details.

options.name: secure_via_header
options.description: When checked (enabled), inserts a secure Via header in the forwarded SIP request. A secure Via header indicates where the message originated. This parameter causes the inserted Via header to specify Transport Layer Security. For this option to take effect, C(insert_via_header) must be set to (true).

options.name: security
options.description: When C(true), enables the use of enhanced Horizontal Security Layer (HSL) security checking.

options.name: state
options.description: When C(present), ensures the profile exists. When C(absent), ensures the profile is removed.

options.name: terminate_on_bye
options.description: When C(true), closes a connection when a BYE transaction finishes. A BYE transaction is a message an application sends to another application when it is ready to close the connection between the two.

options.name: user_via_header
options.description: When C(insert_via_header) is C(true), specifies the Via value the system inserts as the top Via header in a SIP REQUEST message. The valid value must include SIP protocol and sent_by settings, for example: C(SIP/2.0/UDP 10.10.10.10:5060). To remove the entry completely, set a value of C('').
